list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. Names and descriptions as PlayStation publishes them, per Exophase and PSNProfiles via the kit starter list. Guides are this entry's own words; sources are named beside each guide.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing in the list is online, so the whole run is single-player; expect roughly 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist for A Long Road.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — just play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. This is a story trophy, so it pops when the chapter's final mission ends — it cannot be missed, but do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before the chapter closes (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; GTABase GTA 6 trophies list

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy that pops at the end of the chapter; it cannot be missed. Both Jason and Lucia are playable from this chapter on, which opens up most of the open-world trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; GTABase GTA 6 trophies list

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy that pops at the end of the chapter; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; GTABase GTA 6 trophies list

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy that pops at the end of the chapter; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; GTABase GTA 6 trophies list

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Keep a manual save from before it, since the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus — a safety net costs nothing and lets you revisit the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy tied to one mission — play it through and it pops; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Complete the heist mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. A story trophy that cannot be missed — finish the heist and it pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story trophy tied to one mission — play it through and it pops; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story trophy tied to one mission — play it through and it pops; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission at Vice City International Airport. A story trophy tied to one mission — play it through and it pops; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy tied to one mission — play it through and it pops; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress menu, after the story). PowerPyx notes the checklist is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion: 100 optional tasks, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, and 15 of 18 meditation spots. This is the hardest trophy in the set; budget most of the roughly 200 hours here.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Jumps, near-misses and airtime all feed the counter, so chip away at it during free roam between missions rather than grinding it in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. Sample one of everything — a race, a fishing spot, an arcade game, a drone race and the rest — and the trophy pops as soon as the last type is tried.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through each range until the gold threshold is met; there is no difficulty setting, so it is repetition and aim, not luck. All 42 golds are also needed for 100% completion.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's racing line and keep the drone low and tight through the gates; you can retry a location as often as needed.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts; work through the race list across Leonida and pick vehicles that suit each course.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him — steady reeling and watching the line beats frantic input.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any playable arcade cabinet and finish a full game of it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's questline to its end; his missions are optional side content, so check the map for his icon between story chapters and finish each mission as it appears.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's questline to its end, the same pattern as the other character strands — finish each of his missions as it appears.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's questline to its end — finish each of his missions as it appears on the map.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map; eight full strands are needed, so start them early and finish each chain rather than leaving half-done strands scattered around.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's questline to its end — finish each of his missions as it appears on the map.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's questline to its end — finish each of his missions as it appears on the map.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, meditating with both Jason and Lucia where possible. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she goes to the balcony to meditate — follow her and accept. That meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 manual save. 100% completion only needs 15 of the 18 spots.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting strand and track the unique animal he marks — bring a scoped weapon, move quietly, and study the animal through binoculars first, since studying animals also feeds the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: GTABase GTA 6 trophies list; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets of three and check the in-game progress menu to see which cards you still need before sweeping an area again.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to scan photo spots across the map; 100 scanned locations earns it, so scan every spot you pass while exploring rather than hunting them all at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's repeatable feats list — 70 of 80 are needed for 100% completion, so this pops on the way to A Long Road without a separate grind.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden — in alleys, off-road or underwater — until the wanted level clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one wanted-level run with your partner — plan a route of nearby shops, keep moving, and do not let the heat drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or scan new vehicle models as you explore; 200 of 277 base models are needed for 100% completion, so this pops during the same sweep — scan everything you pass.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus in a firefight with at least five enemies grouped up, and chain the kills before the meter runs out — pick a busy shootout rather than a quiet one.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Slip out of Vice City International Airport by an unofficial route — through a fence or over a wall — rather than through the main exit.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; GTABase GTA 6 trophies list

trophies.guide: Take control of a Rhino military tank and meet its hidden combat requirement. Steal a Rhino, then use it in combat until the trophy pops; the exact combat condition is still unconfirmed in the guides published so far, so keep fighting in the tank rather than parking it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, wait for a quiet moment, and get in and out without tripping an alarm or being spotted — a clean run, not a shootout.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan five vault robberies across Leonida and escape cleanly after each — park a fast getaway vehicle nearby before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, crack it open, and lose the heat before the trophy counts — a quiet stretch of highway beats downtown.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area of the map — the trophy tracks map coverage, so sweep the coast, the swamps, the Keys and the back roads, not just Vice City itself.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation per gang across Leonida; each gang's turf reveals its operations once you find them, so work gang by gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the Ocean Beach spot, order or enjoy a cocktail there and take in the view. The exact trigger is unconfirmed in the guides published so far — the description is the only hint, so try the beachfront bars and viewpoints.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's glass front in a dramatic exit. The exact showroom and trigger are unconfirmed — try the big dealership showrooms.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the bowling alley and bowl a full game, following through on the lane. The precise follow-through condition is still being pinned down by the guides, so play a complete game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength attributes to maximum. Train Strength with both characters — gym work, melee and carrying heavy loads — until both stats are maxed. This is a slow grind, so train a little whenever you switch characters.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; GTABase GTA 6 trophies list

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Every crime, stunt and illicit act feeds the profile; 500 actions is a long grind that builds up naturally across the whole playthrough, so do not chase it early.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; GTABase GTA 6 trophies list

trophies.guide: Trigger a hidden second-chance event. The exact method is unconfirmed in every guide published so far; the description is the only hint, so do not chase a specific method until the community pins one down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.guide: Experience a mysterious hidden encounter. The exact trigger is unconfirmed — it is one of the five trophies no guide has pinned down yet, so keep exploring odd corners of Leonida and let it find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — strike targets with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise conditions are unconfirmed, so the bowling alley area is the natural place to try it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your laundering contacts over time until $250,000 is cleaned — it is cumulative, not one job.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades across Leonida's shops — the total is cumulative, so it builds up as you gear up for the rest of the list.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — eight in total. Save up and buy every purchasable garage on the map; they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register ten different vehicles you own or find around Leonida.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: U7BUY GTA 6 trophies guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide
